name: form_selector
label: Selector - Hide While Active / Unhide at 0

name: hide_selector
label: Selector - Unhide While Active / Hide at 0

name: offset_minutes
label: Offset minutes
help_text: Leave at 0. The close is already anchored to the class time in New York (DST included), 72h after Old Class Date. Positive closes EARLIER, negative LATER, in minutes.

name: force_open
label: Ignore countdown - keep replay open
help_text: When on, the countdown is ignored: the form stays visible, the "Unhide at 0" selectors stay hidden, and the clock hides. Set it on every instance of this module on the page.

name: forced_hide_selector
label: Selector - Hide when toggle is on
help_text: Optional. Extra elements to hide while the toggle is on, e.g. the "Replay Expires In:" label. Bare HubSpot ids, comma separated.
